close_reason: Added doc example showing typical call-site usage
description: The doc for check_known_capabilities says 'map any Err to an HTTP 400 response using request_error'. RFC 8620 §3.6.1.1 example shows the error detail includes the unrecognised URI. The doc gives no guidance on how to construct that detail. A contributor reading this doc will call request_error(err) directly and produce a detail-less response. The gap between the doc's instruction and RFC conformance is invisible without also reading response.rs — the call chain is documented nowhere as a unit.
title: doc example for check_known_capabilities doesn't show how to populate detail
